description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Safehold Elite, adding {C}{C}.
Safehold Elite dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a -1/-1 counter from Cinderhaze Wretch, and both counters from Safehold Elite.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Safehold Elite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 3-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Safehold Elite, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Safehold Elite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
